FINDINGS:
- [HIGH] docs/build/roadmap.md:64 - Phase 1 criterion 8 ends "every phase 1 endpoint method rejects unauthenticated callers", and criterion 10 / the Rulings (line 230) require an allowed and a denied test for every generated endpoint method; the Serverpod auth module's own endpoints (sign-in, and by default account registration and password reset) must accept unauthenticated callers, so the criterion cannot pass as written, and the matrix check has no stated rule for module endpoints. The default registration endpoints also contradict "no sign-up screen / accounts only by seed" - fix: state how module endpoints are treated (disable or deny email registration and reset in the server config or by an endpoint override; sign-in is the single listed unauthenticated exception) and scope the unauthenticated-denial clause and the matrix to EduBox endpoints plus that explicit exception list - owner: roadmap
- [HIGH] docs/build/roadmap.md:68, :234 - criterion 12 requires a clean checkout with only the listed prerequisites, but the database and MinIO passwords and other secrets live in the git-ignored `edubox_server/config/passwords.yaml` (line 5, 234; Phase 4 criterion 8 asserts it is git-ignored); a clean checkout has no such file, so test, e2e, and the compose `server` and `seed` services fail at start. Serverpod also needs its own entries there (for example the email auth pepper) - fix: define the bootstrap, for example a committed `passwords.example.yaml` with dev-only values plus a documented copy step in the commands, or compose-supplied `SERVERPOD_PASSWORD_*` environment variables, and keep the real OpenRouter key as the only optional secret - owner: roadmap
- [MEDIUM] docs/build/roadmap.md:6, :17-18 - the compose lifecycle is not executable as written: `up -d --wait` over the `e2e` profile also starts the one-shot `seed` service (it is in that profile), and `--wait` does not reliably accept a service that exits; `seed` then runs a second time through `run --rm seed`; no `server` health check is named, so `seed` and the tests can race the migration; the test command never creates the MinIO bucket (only `seed` does), so the criterion 7 storage test has no bucket or credentials; "seed resets the database" while the server holds connections and has applied migrations would drop the schema - fix: put `seed` in its own profile or drop it from `up`, require a server healthcheck, say who creates the private bucket for `dart test` (test setup or a `minio-init` service), and define reset as truncate of data tables plus emptying the bucket, not schema drop - owner: roadmap
- [MEDIUM] docs/build/roadmap.md:53, :44-46, :61 - the scope moved into phase 1 is justified by the shape briefs (student-home, student-library, parent-home, teacher-home all confirm offline-with-cache and offline-no-cache states), but the drift store list (profile and role, library items, parent's linked child name) omits the teacher's class list that `teacher-home` renders in "Offline, data cached" and "Offline, no cached data"; criterion 5 covers only the student, and no criterion covers recovery (seam back online refreshes the cached screens, the teacher brief's "Đã kết nối lại" state) - fix: add classes to the cached metadata, and extend criterion 5 or add one covering teacher and parent offline states and refresh on reconnect - owner: roadmap
- [MEDIUM] docs/build/roadmap.md:61 - criterion 5's "fresh install that never loaded the library" while signed in and offline has no reachable setup: sign-in and `profile.me` need the server, and the library loads right after. The test must switch the seam offline between sign-in and the first library load, or sign in then clear the library table - fix: state the setup (for example "sign in online, switch the seam offline before the library query, or clear the library cache tables") so the oracle is deterministic - owner: roadmap
- [MEDIUM] docs/build/roadmap.md:54, :61 - the network seam's production source (connectivity events plus server reachability) is not tested in phase 1; only the test switch is. Phase 2's risk line says it is "unit-tested", but no criterion in any phase asserts that. Also the offline start path depends on Serverpod's session manager restoring the cached session without contacting the server (the student-home brief's offline sign-out warning assumes this), which is a real risk for criterion 5 and is not listed - fix: add a unit-test criterion for the production seam source and a Risk for offline session restore - owner: roadmap
- [MEDIUM] docs/build/roadmap.md:59 - criterion 3's "invalid role value": if `users.role` is a Serverpod enum column, the generated model cannot hold an invalid value; the seed needs raw SQL and the server must map the parse failure to the same not-set-up outcome instead of a 500. `profile.me`'s observable result for "no profile" and "invalid role" is never defined - fix: name the outcome (a named error or a typed status) and how the seed creates the invalid row - owner: roadmap
- [MEDIUM] docs/build/roadmap.md:12 - the Serverpod CLI version is "fixed by the phase 1 contract" yet listed as a user-installed prerequisite and needed by criterion 12; the user cannot install it before the contract chooses it, and Serverpod's default compose also ships a Redis service the stack does not list (it must be disabled in config) - fix: pin the version now in Rulings (or let the pipeline run `dart pub global activate`, which is not a system install), and note Redis is off - owner: roadmap
